name: crossref-mcp-server
description: Resolve DOIs, search ~155M scholarly works, fetch references, and look up publishers via the Crossref REST API. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

CROSSREF_MAILTO.title: Crossref polite-pool email
CROSSREF_MAILTO.description: Optional. Sent in the User-Agent header for Crossref's polite pool; without it requests use the anonymous pool with stricter rate limits.
